ai_summary.text:
アルバックは真空技術を基盤とした半導体製造装置と産業用真空装置の大手メーカーで、スパッタリング装置・蒸着装置・CVD装置を主力としている。FPD（フラットパネルディスプレイ）製造用の大型スパッタリング装置で世界的なシェアを持ち、半導体の薄膜形成工程に不可欠な真空技術のリーディングカンパニーとしての地位を確立。

売上2,512億円（前年比-3.8%）と微減収。営業利益265億円（営業利益率10.6%）と二桁の利益率を維持し、純利益167億円。FPD装置の受注端境期が減収の主因だが半導体装置の安定需要が利益率を下支え。ROE7.2%と安定した資本効率。

自己資本比率59.6%と高い水準にあり、財務健全性スコア88点と健全な財務基盤。営業CF348億円、FCF240億円と安定したキャッシュ創出力を確保。EPS339円に対しPER15.7倍、配当164円で配当性向は約48%と手厚い株主還元。半導体の薄膜形成技術とFPD大型基板処理の両輪が事業基盤を支えている。
ai_summary.text_en: Ulvac is a leading manufacturer of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and industrial vacuum equipment based on vacuum technology, with sputtering systems, evaporation systems, and CVD systems as primary products. The company holds significant global market share in large-scale sputtering equipment for FPD (flat panel display) manufacturing and has established itself as a leading company in vacuum technology essential to thin-film formation processes in semiconductors.  Revenue of 251.2 billion yen (YoY -3.8%) showed modest decline. Operating profit of 26.5 billion yen (operating margin 10.6%) maintained double-digit profitability with net income of 16.7 billion yen. The main factor in revenue decline was a cycle of weak FPD equipment orders, though stable semiconductor equipment demand supported profit margins. ROE of 7.2% reflects stable capital efficiency.  Equity ratio of 59.6% is at a strong level, and financial health score of 88 points indicates a sound financial foundation. Operating CF of 34.8 billion yen and FCF of 24.0 billion yen demonstrate stable cash generation capacity. EPS of 339 yen against PER of 15.7x and dividend of 164 yen represent generous shareholder returns with approximately 48% payout ratio. The dual business pillars of semiconductor thin-film formation technology and large-scale FPD substrate processing support the business foundation.
